pages.text: Datura is a crop that can be grown like wheat. It has multiple uses in the mod.$(br)
When the Datura crop reaches maturity, the full-grown plant drops datura. Harvest it before it dies to collect.$(br)

pages.title: Healing Spirits
pages.text: Right-click a spirit with datura to heal it. Works on Familiars, Summoned Spirits, and Possessed Mobs.$(br)

pages.title: Spirit Fire Fuel
pages.text: Throw datura to the ground and light it on fire with flint and steel to create a spirit fire.$(br)

pages.title: Crushing
pages.text: Datura can be crushed by a Crusher spirit to produce seeds for replanting.$(br)
